main_text.p: & quælibet πεντηκοστύς[?] plures quàm quinquaginta complexa fit, ac vel duplo triplove facta fit major, similiterque pro parte ratâ ordines quoque reliqui, tamen apud posteros nomina eadem retinuerunt: quemadmodum in decuriis, centuriis, manipulis, cohortibus, legionibus Romanis, ac in rebus aliis factum olim esse, & hodiè quoque fieri videmus.

VErùm soline pedites gravis armaturæ nomen πεζικὸς[?] dederint, an & equites pauculi, peditibus additi, ad explendum illum numerum accensi olim sint, id ego dubium esse existimo. Quorum hoc Xenophontis verbis, ubi de moris totius civitatis loquitur, conforme videtur: illud autem verosimile magis, propterea quòd equites primis illis temporibus pauculi admodum fuerint, & tantummodò accessio quædam supernumeraria, additamentumve non tam minorum ordinum, quàm totarum morarum: qui deinde in expeditionibus conjuncti ex moris omnibus equitatum à peditum agminibus separatim constituerint. Nam ab initio perexiguus equitum usus fuit apud Lacedæmonios, & robur in eo penè nullum:

page.notes: The Greek word at the start of the second paragraph ("πεζικὸς") and the Greek word in the first paragraph ("πεντηκοστύς") are hard to read exactly; both are marked [?]. The word "soline" is read as printed and may be a misprint for another form; no change was made. The catchword "in" stands at the right below the last line. Dark marks at the left edge near the bottom ("x roi", "x tolol xx") look like show-through or edge marks, not printed text, and were left out. No printing errors were corrected.
